title: Reference and benchmark catalog
description: Catalog of external material this system studies or cites (AES-P0.4 / SUE-437). Entries are pointers with explicit rights metadata. When rights are unclear the entry must be link-only; the repository never becomes a mirror.

creator.description: Author, project, or organisation. Never omitted — attribution starts here.

rights_status.description: clear: license identified and understood. unclear: not identified, ambiguous, or contradictory. Unclear forces link-only.

license.description: SPDX identifier or a plain-language license name. null when rights_status is unclear.

license_compatible.description: Whether the license permits inclusion in this MIT / CC BY 4.0 repository. Required to be true before anything is copied.

copy_status.description: linked: URL and our notes only. quoted: limited attributed excerpt supporting analysis. copied: material reproduced in-repo — permitted only under a compatible license with attribution.

verdict.description: What we decided after studying it.
